name: Avocado
summary: Dark green avocado with a cut half showing pale flesh and the brown stone; for healthy-eating and brunch scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the item rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~350 px wide); use about 0.2-0.3 next to a person

params.name: cut
params.note: half = the cut face lies in front

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = rock on its base, bounce = drop in, roll = roll in from the left, pop = scale in

author: krakujs
